subject: Observability implementation — sprint plan & kickoff
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@catalysthealth.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Observability implementation — sprint plan & next steps

Hi Elaine —

Thanks again for the call today. Per our discussion I sketched a 3-week implementation sprint to get your core observability features live (dashboards, tracing hooks, error taxonomy, alert routing, runbook handoff). High level:

- Week 1: Instrumentation & tracing hooks (service-by-service checklist)
- Week 2: Dashboard templates & error taxonomy adoption; baseline alerts
- Week 3: Runbooks, on-call routing, and final validation (load + chaos smoke)

Ask: please confirm the SRE/infra contact who will accept instrumentation PRs and merge access. Also confirm whether you prefer Jaeger or vendor-managed tracing (we can support both).

I attached an implementation checklist to this message (obs-implementation-checklist.xlsx) and linked a draft runbook template in the shared folder. Proposed kickoff: Mon, May 3rd, 10:00am PT for a 45-min working session to align owners and open the first set of tickets.

If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and a mutual action plan (owner, ticket, and acceptance criteria).

Thanks,
Sooj

Sooj/Diego — a few internal notes after reviewing the checklist and the notes from the discovery call: 

- Narrow scope for week 1 to payments + auth, agree with Elaine. We should capture language-specific tracing snippets in a single living doc to avoid repeat work.
- Alert routing: recommend staging->pager escalation at Sev 1 only for now; use Slack #catalyst-oncall for Sev 2. We’ll hand off final routing once we validate noise.
- Error taxonomy: please adopt the attached v1 taxonomy (error-taxonomy-v1.md). It maps infra vs app vs model errors and ties to runbook playbooks.
- Runbooks: add quick triage checklist and most-likely-remediation steps (3 bullets). I’ll draft a runbook page and attach template.

I’ve attached a draft error taxonomy and flagged two acceptance criteria to include in the MAP: (1) tracing spans for payments include payment_id tag; (2) dashboard SLO cards show 99th latency for auth endpoints.

Marissa

Subject: Final prep & kickoff invite — Observability implementation (May 3)

Hi Elaine / Raj —

Confirming kickoff session: Mon, May 3rd, 10:00am — 10:45am PT. Calendar invite sent. Agenda: quick scope check (payments + auth only), review tracing guidance, map alerts & routing, and assign runbook owners.

What we’ll bring to the meeting:
- Implementation checklist (attached)
- Tracing hooks guidance with language snippets (attached: tracing-hooks-guidance.md)
- Runbook template to populate during the sprint (attached: runbook-template.docx)

Action items before kickoff:
- Raj: confirm service repo access (we need PR permissions to instrumentation branches)
- Elaine: confirm list of service owners for payments + auth
- Catalyst: create a Slack channel #catalyst-oncall and add Marissa + Diego

Acceptance criteria we’ll validate at sprint end:
1) Traces emitted for payments include payment_id and user_id tags
2) Auth endpoints dashboards built with 99th/95th/median latency cards
3) Runbooks for payments+auth populated with triage steps and escalation points

If anything blocks prior to Monday, reply here and we’ll triage. Looking forward to getting this into a working state.

Thanks,
